disposition_rationale: `project.created` remains individually quarantined. Plans/UI_Command_Catalog.md:333-334 declares it as the expected persisted outcome for two project-creation commands, while Plans/UI_Wiring_Rules.md:492-506 only defines the generic wiring-row obligation. Neither citation supplies the actual handler row, accountable semantic owner, versioned membership, closed event payload, scope identity, replay, retention/custody, legal transitions, checkpoint rules, withdrawal, or event-specific oracles. A command-side trigger is not Event Authority, so the missing values require an owner veto and cannot be inferred.
